GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions, answered.

What are nitrous oxide, N2O, laughing gas and lachgas?

Nitrous oxide is the gas referred to by the formula N2O. Laughing gas is its common English name; lachgas is the Dutch name. The cylinders listed here are intended for culinary cream whipping with compatible equipment.

How do I place an order?

Select Order via WhatsApp, then send your product, quantity and delivery address. We will confirm your order details and total.

Can I pay cash on delivery?

Yes. Orders are paid in cash when delivered. Your total and any delivery charge are confirmed in advance.

How long does delivery take?

Message us with your location and product. Availability and a delivery window will be confirmed before dispatch.

Which cylinder fits my dispenser?

Send us your dispenser model and fittings before ordering. Cylinders require suitable equipment; follow the manufacturer’s compatibility instructions.

Can I discuss bulk or repeat orders?

Yes. Send the products, quantities and your business requirements via WhatsApp for a quote.

What are these products intended for?

Culinary use, including whipping cream and preparing aerated recipes with appropriate equipment. Handle, store and use cylinders according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
